item.title: Green hits career-high 7 3s, scores 23 points to help No. 21 Saint Louis rout Dayton 102-71
item.description: Trey Green made a career-high seven 3-pointers and scored 23 points, Ishan Sharma added 18 on six more 3s, and No. 21 Saint Louis beat Dayton 102-71 on Friday night.

item.title: Elise Mertens and Zhang Shuai win the Australian Open women's doubles title
item.description: Elise Mertens has marked her return to the No. 1 ranking in women's doubles by combining with China's Zhang Shuai to win the Australian Open title.

item.title: Nets guard Egor Demin sets NBA rookie record with a 3-pointer in 34th straight game
item.description: Brooklyn Nets guard Egor Demin made a 3-pointer in an NBA rookie-record 34th straight game on Friday night against the Utah Jazz.

item.title: Fire breaks out in South Huntington home
item.description: In addition to the Huntington Manor Fire Department, seven mutual aid departments have also responded to the scene, officials said.

item.title: No. 3 Michigan beats No. 7 Michigan State 83-71, takes sole possession of 1st place in Big Ten
item.description: Yaxel Lendeborg had 26 points and 12 rebounds, Elliot Cadeau scored 17 and Morez Johnson added 12 points to lead No. 3 Michigan to an 83-71 victory over seventh-ranked Michigan State on Friday night.

item.title: Bane leads Magic's rally in fourth quarter to beat Raptors 130-120
item.description: Desmond Bane scored 16 of his 32 points in the fourth quarter to help the Orlando Magic overcome a 13-point deficit and beat the Toronto Raptors 130-120.

item.title: Coyle's three-goal game leads Blue Jackets to a 4-2 win over the Blackhawks
item.description: Charlie Coyle had his second career hat trick, Mathieu Olivier added a goal and an assist and the Columbus Blue Jackets beat the Chicago Blackhawks 4-2 on Friday night.

item.title: Suns sweep back-to-back, ending Cavaliers' winning streak at 5 with 126-113 victory
item.description: Dillon Brooks scored 27 points and the Phoenix Suns beat Cleveland 126-113 on Friday night to sweep a back-to-back and end the Cavaliers' winning streak at a season-best five games.

item.title: Nikola Jokic returns from knee injury to lead Nuggets past Clippers, 122-109
item.description: Nikola Jokic had 31 points and 12 rebounds in his first game in a month, Tim Hardaway Jr. added 22 points and the Denver Nuggets knocked off the Los Angeles Clippers 122-109 on Friday night.

item.title: Iraqi calligrapher's handwritten Quran ends 6 years of artistry and craft
item.description: Iraqi calligrapher Ali Zaman has completed a colossal handwritten Quran manuscript after six years of work.
